item.title: Sliding log
item.text: Keeps a timestamp for every request.

item.title: Token bucket
item.text: Spends tokens that refill at a steady rate.

say.title: Choices
say.text: [Three ways to limit](#limiter-choices) trade memory for accuracy. A [fixed window](#fixed-window) is cheap but lets a double burst through at the boundary, a [sliding log](#sliding-log) is exact but stores every request, and the [token bucket](#token-bucket) sits between them.

item: def take(self, now): gained = (now - self.last) * self.rate self.tokens = min(self.capacity, self.tokens + gained) self.last = now if self.tokens >= 1: self.tokens -= 1 return True return False

say.title: Refill then spend
say.text: [Spending a token](#take-code) starts by [topping the bucket up](#take-code:L2-3 'gained = ...+ gained)'): elapsed time times the rate, capped at [the capacity](#take-code:L3 'self.capacity'). Then [one request costs one token](#take-code:L6 'self.tokens -= 1'), and an empty bucket [returns False](#take-code:L8 'return False').

item.title: Use a monotonic clock
item.text: One change stops refills jumping when the wall clock moves.

say.title: Monotonic clock
say.text: [Use a monotonic clock](#clock-diff) because [the old call](#clock-before:L4 'time.time()') reads the wall clock, which can jump back. [The new call](#clock-after:L4 'time.monotonic()') only moves forward, so a clock change can no longer hand out a free refill.

say.title: Overview
say.text: [Inside the bucket](#bucket-parts) four ideas work together to decide every request, and seeing them side by side shows why bursts pass while a steady flood is slowed to the rate you chose.

say.title: Capacity
say.text: [Capacity](#q-capacity) is the size of the jar. It sets the largest burst that can pass at once.

say.title: Refill
say.text: [The refill rate](#q-refill) is how many tokens drip in per second. It fixes the long-run average.

say.title: Spending
say.text: [Spending](#q-spend) takes one token for one request. A request with a token goes through the door.

say.title: Rejection
say.text: [Rejection](#q-reject) happens when the jar is empty. The caller is told to retry later.

say.title: Together
say.text: [Together](#bucket-parts) capacity, refill, spending and rejection make a limiter that forgives bursts and still holds the average.
